run.termination: GDB killed the inferior at the first retail software-queue wait; clean title shutdown was not observed.

supported: The exact retail XEX and host executable hashes were recorded; the mapped GPU DSO hash was verified in the same Linux AMD64 inferior. The runtime DSO was resolved from its staged path but its mapped hash was not re-read in this inferior.

Two hardware watchpoints on the guest virtual mapping of interrupt-context offsets +0x10 and +0x14 were armed on the first source-0 callback and neither stopped execution before the first retail software-queue wait.

At the first wait the interrupt record still contained a zero callback target and zero argument; the wait target 13 lay between queue head 3 and tail 21, while predicate byte 0x14 did not contain completion mask 0x02.
The trace log contains no source-1 callback before the first wait.
not_proven: That no write occurred through another host alias or a GPU/device DMA path; the watchpoints covered only the selected guest virtual host mapping.
That the renderer submitted or executed the specific memory-mode WAIT_REG_MEM packets associated with these context fields in this same run.
That the missing event belongs to the renderer, ReXGlue dispatch, or retail scheduling.
Main-menu entry, offline-race entry, sustained visible output, or a clean title shutdown.
interpretation.next_step: Trace whether the current renderer consumes the exact retail memory-mode WAIT_REG_MEM packets, translates their guest address to the interrupt-context fields, and dispatches source 1 only after the retail values are written. Preserve the original queue and predicate semantics.

limitations: The GDB run was intrusive and ended at the first software-queue wait.
The two hardware watchpoints monitored writes through the guest virtual mapping at 0x1FB963010 and 0x1FB963014; other host aliases and GPU/device DMA writes are outside this probe.
The runtime log's unsupported WAIT_REG_MEM messages describe register-space forms (memory=false); they are not identified as the exact callback-record packets.
The run used Linux GPU DSO commit 3f4a779049410d7e1b48e39cba6c41c0bd794087; the separately reported Android disclaimer-texture build was not staged in this Linux run.
